comment: The both-lines gate of BD-204 (marker_guard.py lines, test-winsys-lines.ps1). A fix marker (a BD id in a comment
under 'paths', or in the subject of a commit since the merge base of the pair that touches them) on one RADV WDDM
line and not on the other fails, unless an entry of 'accept' says why. Each line is the commit that
release-sources.json pins for its payload path. Kinds: contract (one of the four differences the hosted line may
have: kernel object owner, presentation, device-loss channel, call macro), line-only (the code is on that line
only), equivalent (the other line holds the fix as the named commits, which the gate checks), open (known drift,
printed on every run, BD-204 step 3). An entry that matches no difference any more fails as stale. A 'both_lines'
fix must match its pattern under its path on every line. First written for the tester.38 pins: system 3b660ba0,
hosted e51ad6ea. The wow64 and desktop lines are not paired yet: at those pins they differ from their partner
line by 17 (system-wow64) and 14 (hosted-desktop) markers, which nobody has reviewed.

both_lines.name: BD-201 a destroyed BO is held until the queues' work retires
BD-202 VK_EXT_memory_budget reports the bytes of live BOs

accept.reason: The ACO LDS spill fix of the system line (630b3766) is on the hosted line as 1c0099b9, same subject. The LUID winsys cache of the same merge is for the standalone winsys only.
The shared-surface layout comments of radv_image.c and radv_shared_layout.h are on the system line only. BD-204 names the image layout part of this as drift; not ported at the tester.38 pins.
The sliced fence wait (a wait past one slice on a live device is not a loss) is on the hosted line as 154050d5. The BC250_BVH_BUILD diagnostic switch is on the system line only.
Presentation: the DXGI present route of the system ICD (radv_wddm2_wsi_route.h). The hosted ICD never presents.
The layout check of an image that aliases a D3D shared resource. BD-204 names it as drift that the hosted line lacks; not ported at the tester.38 pins.
Presentation: the independent flip host test of the Win32 WSI. The hosted ICD never presents.
Presentation: the scan-out formats of the DXGI Vulkan present route. The hosted ICD never presents.
The memory budget came to the hosted line first (ada2f006, 54cff600); BD-202 is its port to the system line.
Honest external memory properties came to the hosted line first as BD-038 (810e3ebb); BD-203 is the system line's version of it.
The comment in radv_wddm2_bo.c names this drift row: it explains the part that the system line took from the hosted line. It is no fix of its own.
Presentation: the present worker of the GDI route in wsi_common_win32.cpp. The hosted ICD never presents.
Presentation: the destruction of the Vulkan half of a Win32 swapchain image. The hosted ICD never presents.
Kernel object owner: in hosted mode the D3D runtime owns the allocations and no Win32 handle is imported. The system line has its own version as BD-203.
Kernel object owner: what vkAllocateMemory accepts with a host import (radv_host_import.h). A host import exists in hosted mode only.
Kernel object owner: an owned BO whose CPU lock the host (the D3D runtime's callbacks) will not release. The system line calls D3DKMT itself.
radv_bc250_dgc.c, the mesh DGC of the D3D12 shell's ExecuteIndirect, is on the hosted line only.
No preamble idle wait when the winsys releases a BO only after the queued work retires. The system line has that release since BD-201, but not this change; not ported at the tester.38 pins.
The query sites of the BC-250 DGC program in radv_bc250_dgc.c, which is on the hosted line only.
